name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.25.1: no behaviour change. This build exists to prove the Claude Code deploy path end to end before it is trusted with a real change - commit and push from a terminal-less workflow, Railway picking it up from the repo, and the running version reporting 6.25.1. Carries one comment recording why Cache-Control on index.html is load-bearing: the dashboard is served from disk per request with no build step, so a cached index.html means stale dashboard JS running against a changed API, which presents as a confusing intermittent fault rather than an obvious one. That constraint was previously only written down outside the source. Cumulative over v6.25.
